```{=html}
<!-- =====================================================
     SDS LAB | Birthday banner + confetti (HOME ONLY)
     기존 styles.css / _quarto.yml 수정 없음
     ===================================================== -->
<style>
  /* 이 섹션의 모든 디자인은 sds-birthday 접두어로 격리 */
  .sds-birthday-area {
    position: relative;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: min(1280px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    max-width: none;
    margin: 22px 0 82px;
    isolation: isolate;
  }

  /* 평소에는 두루마리의 파란 봉만 보임 */
  .sds-birthday-rod {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    height: 19px;
    margin: 0 8px;
    border: 2px solid #074f81;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg,
      #005585 0%, #2295bd 28%, #f6dd80 45%,
      #0071a2 59%, #003d70 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .19);
  }
  .sds-birthday-rod::before,
  .sds-birthday-rod::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -5px;
    width: 11px;
    height: 24px;
    border: 2px solid #a96f0a;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #f7c83d;
  }
  .sds-birthday-rod::before { left: -9px; }
  .sds-birthday-rod::after { right: -9px; }

  /* 현수막 펼침 시간: 아래 ??s를 조절하면 됨.
     고정된 픽셀 높이로 펼치므로 진행 속도가 균일하고 실제로 4.5초 소요됨. */
  .sds-birthday-curtain {
    height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 11px;
    transition: height 1.7s linear;
  }
  .sds-birthday-fabric {
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .sds-birthday-paper {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 28px) clamp(8px, 1.6vw, 20px);
    border-right: 7px solid #2da64b;
    border-left: 7px solid #2da64b;
    border-bottom: 11px solid #006396;
    background: #fffdf3;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #dfd5a1, 0 8px 17px rgba(0, 0, 0, .11);
    color: #242424;
  }

  /* 레퍼런스처럼 원색의 장식 띠를 양쪽에 배치 */
  .sds-birthday-paper::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: .90;
    background: linear-gradient(113deg,
      transparent 0 3.5%, #ffd747 3.5% 5.5%,
      #ef4848 5.5% 7.5%, #20a44a 7.5% 9.5%,
      transparent 9.5% 90.5%, #20a44a 90.5% 92.5%,
      #ef4848 92.5% 94.5%, #ffd747 94.5% 96.5%,
      transparent 96.5%);
  }
  .sds-birthday-layout {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: clamp(56px, 8.5vw, 112px) minmax(0, 1fr) clamp(56px, 8.5vw, 112px);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(7px, 1vw, 16px);
  }
  .sds-birthday-seal {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: clamp(49px, 6.5vw, 88px);
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    margin: auto;
    border: 5px double #fff7e8;
    border-radius: 50%;
    outline: 4px solid #dc3842;
    background: #e83e48;
    color: #fff !important;
    font-family: "Gungsuh", "궁서", "GungsuhChe", "Batang", "AppleMyungjo", serif;
    font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 55px);
    font-weight: 900;
    line-height: 1;
    text-shadow: 1px 2px 1px rgba(105, 0, 0, .28);
    box-shadow: 0 3px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .13);
  }
  .sds-birthday-words {
    min-width: 0;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .sds-birthday-main {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: .25em;
    color: #252525 !important;
    font-family: "Arial Black", "Malgun Gothic", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(29px, 4.4vw, 69px);
    font-weight: 950;
    letter-spacing: -.065em;
    line-height: 1.13;
    -webkit-text-stroke: .55px currentColor;
  }
  .sds-birthday-main span { white-space: nowrap; }
  .sds-birthday-subtitle {
    margin-top: clamp(7px, 1.1vw, 14px);
    color: #18812d !important;
    font-family: "Malgun Gothic", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(12px, 1.55vw, 20px);
    font-weight: 850;
    letter-spacing: -.035em;
    line-height: 1.35;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }

  /* 폭죽 버튼은 현수막 우측 하단 '바깥'에 배치 */
  #sds-birthday-button {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 8px);
    right: 9px;
    z-index: 4;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: clamp(56px, 5vw, 74px);
    height: clamp(56px, 5vw, 74px);
    min-width: 56px;
    min-height: 56px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background: transparent;
    appearance: none;
    color: inherit;
    font-family: "Segoe UI Emoji", "Apple Color Emoji", "Noto Color Emoji", sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(43px, 4.3vw, 60px);
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .22));
    transition: transform .2s ease, filter .2s ease;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }
  #sds-birthday-button:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-10deg) scale(1.1);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .28));
  }
  #sds-birthday-button:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid #006396;
    outline-offset: 3px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
  #sds-birthday-button.sds-birthday-popped {
    animation: sdsBirthdayPop .35s ease;
  }
  @keyframes sdsBirthdayPop {
    0% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); }
    45% { transform: scale(1.23) rotate(-12deg); }
    75% { transform: scale(.97) rotate(7deg); }
    100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0); }
  }

  /* 태블릿/작은 PC: 글씨가 작아지지 않도록 2줄로 변경 */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .sds-birthday-main {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
      font-size: clamp(24px, 5vw, 43px);
      line-height: 1.12;
    }
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .sds-birthday-area {
      width: calc(100vw - 20px);
      margin-top: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 78px;
    }
    .sds-birthday-curtain { margin: 0 6px; }
    .sds-birthday-rod { margin: 0 6px; }
    .sds-birthday-paper {
      padding: 18px 5px 15px;
      border-left-width: 4px;
      border-right-width: 4px;
      border-bottom-width: 8px;
    }
    .sds-birthday-layout {
      grid-template-columns: 43px minmax(0, 1fr) 43px;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .sds-birthday-seal {
      width: 37px;
      border-width: 3px;
      outline-width: 2px;
      font-size: 25px;
    }
    .sds-birthday-main {
      font-size: clamp(20px, 5.4vw, 28px);
      letter-spacing: -.08em;
      -webkit-text-stroke: .2px currentColor;
    }
    .sds-birthday-subtitle {
      margin-top: 7px;
      font-size: clamp(11px, 2.8vw, 13px);
      line-height: 1.25;
    }
  }
  @media (max-width: 350px) {
    /* 아주 좁은 화면: '일동 -'만 혼자 떨어지지 않게 의도적으로 줄바꿈 */
    .sds-birthday-subtitle span { display: block; }
    #sds-birthday-button {
      right: 3px;
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      font-size: 46px;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .sds-birthday-curtain,
    #sds-birthday-button { transition: none; }
    #sds-birthday-button.sds-birthday-popped { animation: none; }
  }
</style>

<div class="sds-birthday-area" id="sds-birthday-area">
  <div class="sds-birthday-rod" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="sds-birthday-curtain" id="sds-birthday-curtain" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="sds-birthday-fabric">
      <div class="sds-birthday-paper">
        <div class="sds-birthday-layout">
          <div class="sds-birthday-seal" aria-label="경">경</div>
          <div class="sds-birthday-words">
            <div class="sds-birthday-main">
              <span>이상일 교수님</span>
              <span>생신</span>
            </div>
            <div class="sds-birthday-subtitle"><span>- 서울대학교 공간데이터분석</span> <span>연구실 일동 -</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="sds-birthday-seal" aria-label="축">축</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button type="button" id="sds-birthday-button"
    aria-controls="sds-birthday-curtain" aria-expanded="false"
    aria-label="현수막 펼치고 생일 축하 폭죽 터뜨리기"
    title="Happy Birthday! 🎉">🎉</button>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  const area = document.getElementById("sds-birthday-area");
  const button = document.getElementById("sds-birthday-button");
  const curtain = document.getElementById("sds-birthday-curtain");
  if (!area || !button || !curtain) return;
  const fabric = curtain.querySelector(".sds-birthday-fabric");
  if (!fabric) return;

  // 펼쳐지는 동안에는 실제 높이(px)를 애니메이션하고,
  // 끝나면 auto로 바꿔 모바일 회전과 창 크기 변경에도 적응시킴.
  curtain.addEventListener("transitionend", function (event) {
    if (event.target === curtain && event.propertyName === "height" &&
        area.classList.contains("is-open")) {
      curtain.style.height = "auto";
    }
  });

  // 캔버스를 body에 두어 Quarto의 본문 너비/오버플로에 영향받지 않게 함
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  canvas.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;" +
    "pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;";
  document.body.appendChild(canvas);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return;

  const palette = ["#ff547e", "#ffd53e", "#3fc3ee", "#62ce70", "#aa79e8",
    "#ff854a", "#e6453f", "#fff2a8", "#5f9af0", "#d2ed65"];
  const DURATION = 5000;
  const FADE = 700;
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let particles = [];
  let startedAt = 0;
  let frameId = null;
  let w = 0, h = 0;

  function fitCanvas() {
    const scale = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    w = window.innerWidth;
    h = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * scale);
    canvas.height = Math.round(h * scale);
    ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
  }
  fitCanvas();
  window.addEventListener("resize", fitCanvas, { passive: true });

  function createConfetti() {
    const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x0 = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
    const y0 = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    const count = w < 600 ? 125 : 220;
    particles = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 115 + Math.random() * 370;
      return {
        x0, y0,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 75,
        width: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
        height: 5 + Math.random() * 9,
        color: palette[i % palette.length],
        rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
        spin: (Math.random() - .5) * 11,
        phase: Math.random() * 7,
        circle: Math.random() < .14
      };
    });
  }

  function animate(now) {
    const elapsed = now - startedAt;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    if (elapsed >= DURATION) {
      particles = [];
      frameId = null;
      return;
    }
    const t = elapsed / 1000;
    const alpha = Math.min(1, (DURATION - elapsed) / FADE);
    for (const p of particles) {
      // 처음에는 사방으로 퍼지고 이후 중력과 좌우 흔들림이 작용
      const x = p.x0 + p.vx * t + Math.sin(5 * t + p.phase) * 7;
      const y = p.y0 + p.vy * t + 0.5 * 130 * t * t;
      if (x < -20 || x > w + 20 || y < -20 || y > h + 20) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot + p.spin * t);
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      if (p.circle) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, p.width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.fillRect(-p.width / 2, -p.height / 2, p.width, p.height);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
    frameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  button.addEventListener("click", function () {
    // A방식: 처음에만 펼치고, 다시 눌러도 현수막은 그대로 유지
    if (!area.classList.contains("is-open")) {
      // height: auto / grid fractional rows가 아니라, 실제 현수막 높이로 전환.
      // CSS에 지정한 시간 동안 일정한 속도로 펼쳐짐.
      const fullHeight = Math.ceil(fabric.getBoundingClientRect().height);
      area.classList.add("is-open");
      curtain.style.height = reducedMotion.matches ? "auto" : `${fullHeight}px`;
      curtain.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
      button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      button.setAttribute("aria-label", "생일 축하 폭죽 다시 터뜨리기");
    }
    button.classList.remove("sds-birthday-popped");
    void button.offsetWidth;
    button.classList.add("sds-birthday-popped");

    if (frameId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
    frameId = null;
    particles = [];
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    if (reducedMotion.matches) return;
    fitCanvas();
    createConfetti();
    startedAt = performance.now();
    frameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  });
  button.addEventListener("animationend", function () {
    button.classList.remove("sds-birthday-popped");
  });
})();
</script>
```
